correctness.rationale: The circular word model has 6 positive pairwise distinct counts c_uv for u≠v and zero loop counts. Conservation of directed degree at each symbol forces c01−c10=c12−c21=c20−c02=δ≠0. Orient the three paired differences positively, write lower counts y=(a,a+p,a+p+q), upper counts y+d, with a,p,q,d positive integers and d not equal p,q,p+q. All 6-value increasing interleavings are the five Dyck words OCOCOC, OCOOCC, OOCCOC, OOCOCC, OOOCCC. Their strict inequality regimes yield minimal (a,p,q,d) respectively (1,2,2,1), (1,3,1,2), (1,1,3,2), (1,2,2,3), (1,1,1,3), under the exact length function 6a+4p+2q+3d, with minimal lengths 21,26,22,27,21. Each type gives 2 orientations×3! arc pair orders=12 distinct rank orders, so 60 total and min-length histogram {21:24,22:12,26:12,27:12}; worst shortest length 27. Each positive balanced multigraph is strongly connected/Eulerian and gives an actual circular homopolymer-free word. Independent six-integer count enumeration over all distinct positive vectors of sum ≤27 visited 21,600 vectors, 216 balanced, recovered 60 ranks and exact histogram; the parametric all-length proof independently excludes arbitrarily long unsearched witnesses. The coarse count 60 is prior-derived, not independently novel.
